summary: Arvinas Inc. filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, disclosing a strategic re-prioritization of its pipeline. The company completed dose escalation enrollment of a Phase 1 trial for ARV-806 and will complete the monotherapy dose escalation while seeking an out-licensing agreement for any further clinical trials, including dose expansion or combinations. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors are stated. The company expects existing cash to fund operations into H2 2028. Watch for potential partnership announcements or further pipeline rationalization; no risk-arb spread applies as no deal is pending.
